title: Wire up backend routes, DB, auth middleware, and frontend auth flow
description: The deployed main.py is a skeleton that only serves /api/health. The api_router in router.py has all sub-routers wired but is never included in the app. The lifespan has no DB engine init, no session dependency overrides, and no AuthMiddleware. Frontend never checks auth state or redirects authenticated users. This epic covers: (1) wiring main.py with api_router, DB engine, session overrides, AuthMiddleware; (2) adding /api/auth/me endpoint; (3) frontend auth state initialization and conditional routing.
